text.p: WCE canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0830 CDT.

CANOLA - C$1.00 to C$2.00 a tonne higher on firm CBOT soycomplex calls, Thursday's bullishly construed NOPA crush of 25.632 million bushels leading to speculation Friday's COPA crush may be bullish as well and persistent rumours of Mexican buying fueling purchases. July WCE futures crush margin rose to -5.22 Thursday from -5.82 Wednesday. New crop November seen up C$0.60 to C$372 with gains limited by ideal growing conditions. Canada's dollar was down at C$1.3786 versus the U.S. dollar, flat at 83.94 yen, up at 1.2609 marks.
FLAXSEED - C$0.40 to C$0.90 a tonne down on lack of hedges, commercial scale down buying and spill over support from allied markets.

WESTERN BARLEY - C$0.50 to C$1.00 up on C$5 to C$6 a tonne cash premiums offered by southern Alberta feedlots due to a shortage of supply and firm CBOT corn calls as well as oversold signals on technical charts.
FEED WHEAT - C$0.50 to C$1.00 up on U.S. corn and wheat calls with technical gaps seen above the market.
FEED PEAS - Steady to US$0.50 up on oversold sentiments in the February contract.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
